title: Host Registry
description: Alias-based SSH host registry for the Agentic OS. No credentials, no keys, no ports with secrets. Connectivity lives in ~/.ssh/config.

hosts.description: Map of host alias (key) to host entry (value). Alias must be an identifier.

HostEntry.description: A single host registration. All fields are optional; aliases resolve via ~/.ssh/config.

ssh_alias.description: SSH alias that must resolve via ~/.ssh/config. No credentials here.

user.description: Remote username (informational; real auth is via ~/.ssh/config).

ssh_options.description: Extra ssh(1) options passed to ssh commands for this host (e.g. ["-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes"]).

paths.description: Notable paths on this host (informational registry data, not mounts).

HostPath.description: A notable directory or file on the remote host.

path.description: Absolute path on the remote host.

purpose.description: Short description of this path's role.
